_about: AI-assisted: researched and assembled with ChatGPT (OpenAI). See docs/AI_USAGE.md. Snapshot compiled 2026-09-26 from Montenegrin appellate and trial outcomes reported by Vijesti, Serbian Interior Ministry statements carried by RTS, and Europol. June 2026 convictions are final; July 2026 convictions are first-instance and may be appealed. The Vračar clan is a separately named sub-clan per Europol, not an interchangeable name for the entire Kavač clan. Publicly named defendants and senior figures only; allegations are labeled, country-level historical associations only, no operational routes or enforcement gaps, no photos without verified reuse rights.
